chain.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON with object keys sorted at every level, arrays kept in file order, comma and colon separators with no spaces, and no trailing newline
chain.input: one object holding the entry without its chain record under the key entry, and the previous entry chain hash, or null for the first entry in the queue, under the key previous
chain.order: one chain over the entries queue and one over the proposals queue; monthly files in name order, entries in file order inside each file
chain.root: chain.json at the repository root holds each queue head hash and entry count, regenerated by tools/build_chain.py

original_hash.input: the bytes of the original file, or the bytes of the repository file that serves the original page, at the time of the check

seal.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON with object keys sorted at every level, arrays kept in file order, comma and colon separators with no spaces, and no trailing newline

states.definition: Brought to the Index and not yet adopted by a human.
states.label: Proposed
states.name: proposed

states.definition: A named human states that they were present or saw the original as it happened.
states.label: Witnessed
states.name: witnessed

states.definition: A named human adopted the entry after reopening the original and running the stated check.
states.label: Verified
states.name: verified

states.definition: A named person contests the entry, with ground attached, and the dispute stays attached.
states.label: Disputed
states.name: disputed

states.definition: The entry was wrong in a stated part, and a linked correction follows it.
states.label: Corrected
states.name: corrected

states.definition: The entry did not hold, and its reason and replacement stay shown.
states.label: Fallen
states.name: fallen
